proposed_changes.rationale: NSAID-up-to-1-yr-before-OA-diagnosis is a proxy for existing disease = label leakage via feature (MLGG-F01/F02), invalidating the prediction claim.
Missing baseline comparison is a methodological gap but doesn't invalidate findings; fits MEDIUM (missing ablation/comparison).
Lack of age/sex matching and control contamination discussion is a study-design refinement, not a leakage or split violation.
Reviewer flags a missed sub-analysis opportunity (BMI multi-omics disentanglement), not a methodological flaw — fits MEDIUM (missing subgroup analysis).
Missing ablation of structured vs unstructured contribution is publication-rigor gap (incomplete ablation), not validity-threatening.
Missing ethnicity/comorbidity demographics is a reporting completeness gap, not a validity-killer (no leakage / no test-set tuning).
Missing TRIPOD checklist reference is a citation/reporting-guideline polish, classic LOW.
Missing code link is a reproducibility gap; doesn't invalidate findings — fits MEDIUM polish category.
PPV 1.7% misinterpretation is a clinical-utility / metric-interpretation problem, fixable in revision; not leakage or split violation.
Clarifying ICD-10 prediction semantics is unclear feature provenance — fits MEDIUM.
Reviewer asks for more analysis of domain shift; external validation was performed — fits MEDIUM (missing subgroup/explanatory analysis).
CT-slice/histology correlation detail is a methodological-clarity gap, not an invalidating leakage or split issue.
Reviewer asks whether DLS is only measuring tumor size — fits MEDIUM (missing ablation / interpretability).
Missing multivariate analysis for independent prediction is a publication-rigor gap (missing ablation/multivariate), not invalidating.
Missing treatment-subgroup split (single vs combo immunotherapy) is missing subgroup analysis — MEDIUM.
General lack of reproducibility detail is publication-grade polish, not invalidating.
Clinical-utility framing concern about easy cases is a subgroup-analysis ask — MEDIUM.
~50% malignancy vs <5% community prevalence is a cohort-definition violation that fundamentally biases the model and limits external validity (MLGG cohort_definition_gate).
Reproducibility-detail gap; concerning but not validity-invalidating.
Missing ART covariate adjustment is missing-covariate concern, fits MEDIUM (unclear feature provenance / missing ablation).
Inadequate multi-group comparison strategy is a methodological-completeness flaw, fixable in revision; not leakage / split / future-info.
Missing confounder/timing description is reporting/clarity gap, not a leakage or split-protocol violation.
